# Dikaris

> Independent forensic investigation, laboratory analysis and wildlife forensics. Based in Enschede, The Netherlands. Named for Dike, the Greek goddess of justice.

Dikaris works for authorities, courts, organisations and private clients. Every case follows the same discipline: secure the evidence, analyse it with validated methods, document each step so findings stand up to scrutiny.

## Services

- Scene investigation: locating, recording, collecting and preserving traces with a documented chain of custody
- Laboratory analysis: biological, DNA and trace evidence examined under controlled, documented conditions
- Evidence examination: physical evidence with measurable, reproducible results and expert reporting
- Methods: aerial survey, 3D laser scanning, thermal imaging, microscopy, expert reports, court testimony

## Wildlife forensics

- Field sampling and evidence recovery
- Species identification
- Acoustic and motion monitoring
- Remote sensing
- Dikaris Wildlife Forensic Kits
